verdict.rationale: The evidence shows request-driven developer building blocks, not a product feature for setting up automations that run in the background. The Agents API, which 'autonomously execute[s] tasks', and Agents Handoffs, described as 'workflow automation', both run when a developer calls them. Batch processing is a one-off asynchronous inference job. Nothing in the pack documents scheduled, recurring, or event-triggered automations that the product runs on the user's behalf.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
